description: This file defines functions, classes, and templates related to leak checking and leak sanitizer management within the Abseil C++ library, specifically for LeakSanitizer (LSan) and AddressSanitizer (ASan).

classes.name: LeakCheckDisabler
classes.description: A helper class that disables leak checking within its scope, preventing reported leaks for heap allocations made during its lifetime.

methods.name: IgnoreLeak
methods.description: Template function that instructs the leak sanitizer to ignore leak warnings on the specified object pointer and all transitively referenced heap objects.

methods.name: LeakCheckDisabler
methods.description: Constructor and destructor that disable and re-enable leak checking within a scope.
